dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……。朝倉くんを信じよう」
dialogues.en: "Alright... I'll put my trust in you, Aaskura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Alright... I'll put my trust in you, Aaskura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
次の日、俺はさくらと病院に出向き、お父さん
に環を救う方法があると伝えた。
dialogues.en:
The next day, Sakura and I visited the hospital, and told
Tamaki's father of the rescue plan.
dialogues.text:
The next day, Sakura and I visited the hospital, and told
Tamaki's father of the rescue plan.

dialogues.jp: もちろん、その方法自体は伝えていない。
dialogues.en:
In truth, we definitely couldn't tell him of the details of
the plan itself.
dialogues.text:
In truth, we definitely couldn't tell him of the details of
the plan itself.

dialogues.jp: ただ、環を救いたいから……と。
dialogues.en: Just that it'd save Tamaki...
dialogues.text: Just that it'd save Tamaki...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「君は、芳乃さんとこのもうひとりのお孫さん
　だね。少しだけ覚えているよ。芳乃さんは妻
　と仲が良かったみたいだからね」
dialogues.en:
"You would be Yoshino-san's other grandchild? I remember
you... Yoshino-san and my wife were good friends."
dialogues.text:
"You would be Yoshino-san's other grandchild? I remember
you... Yoshino-san and my wife were good friends."

dialogues.jp:
お父さんは、さくらを見て、懐かしそうな顔を
していた。
dialogues.en: A nostalgic look graced his face as he gazed at Sakura.
dialogues.text: A nostalgic look graced his face as he gazed at Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
「それじゃあ、環──環さんを預からせてもら
　います」
dialogues.en: "So, could you please let us take Tamaki...san?"
dialogues.text: "So, could you please let us take Tamaki...san?"

dialogues.jp: お父さんがこくりと頷く。
dialogues.en: He nodded.
dialogues.text: He nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「環は、幸せ者だよ。君から、そんなに想って
　もらえて」
dialogues.en:
"Tamaki is very lucky, to have someone like you thinking of
her so much."
dialogues.text:
"Tamaki is very lucky, to have someone like you thinking of
her so much."

dialogues.jp: にっこりと笑う、お父さん。
dialogues.en: He smiled gently as he spoke.
dialogues.text: He smiled gently as he spoke.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「これが、妻の言っていた『深い絆』なのかも
　しれないな」
dialogues.en:
"Perhaps this is what my wife meant by that "deep bond" you
and Tamaki share..."
dialogues.text:
"Perhaps this is what my wife meant by that "deep bond" you
and Tamaki share..."

dialogues.jp: 深い……絆。俺と環の……絆？
dialogues.en: Deep... bond. The bond between Tamaki... and I?
dialogues.text: Deep... bond. The bond between Tamaki... and I?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.jp:
「ここは、私に任せておきなさい。さあ、早く
　｛・・・・・／環のところ｝へ行ってやってくれ」
dialogues.en:
"Allow me to handle the matters here. Please hurry off with
Tamaki."
dialogues.text:
"Allow me to handle the matters here. Please hurry off with
Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki's Father
dialogues.en: "...Thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ベッドに寝ている環をゆっくりと担ぎ上
げ、背に負ぶった。
dialogues.en:
I slowly sat the still-unconscious Tamaki up, and lifted her
onto my back.
dialogues.text:
I slowly sat the still-unconscious Tamaki up, and lifted her
onto my back.

dialogues.jp: 唯一の方法……。
dialogues.en: The only method...
dialogues.text: The only method...

dialogues.jp: それは、環の夢の中に、直接入り込むこと。
dialogues.en: To directly enter Tamaki's dream world.
dialogues.text: To directly enter Tamaki's dream world.

dialogues.jp:
環が眠っている原因を、うまく取り除くことが
できれば、環の意識を回復させられるだろう、
dialogues.en:
Take away the source of her eternal sleep, and she should
regain consciousness.
dialogues.text:
Take away the source of her eternal sleep, and she should
regain consciousness.

dialogues.jp: と、さくらが言った。
dialogues.en: That's what Sakura theorized.
dialogues.text: That's what Sakura theorized.

dialogues.jp: そんなことできるのか？
dialogues.en: Can you really do something like that?
dialogues.text: Can you really do something like that?

dialogues.jp: と、俺が尋ねると、
dialogues.en: And in reply to my question,
dialogues.text: And in reply to my question,

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃん、ボクを誰だと思ってんの？　お
　ばあちゃんの孫だよ」
dialogues.en:
"Onii-chan, who do you think my grandma is? I'm HER
granddaughter."
dialogues.text:
"Onii-chan, who do you think my grandma is? I'm HER
granddaughter."

dialogues.jp: と答えてた。
dialogues.en: She answered.
dialogues.text: She answered.

dialogues.jp: 信じられん……。
dialogues.en: It's still hard to believe...
dialogues.text: It's still hard to believe...

dialogues.jp: 同じ孫でも、こうも能力に差があるのか……。
dialogues.en: We're both her grandkids, but she has that kind of power...
dialogues.text: We're both her grandkids, but she has that kind of power...

dialogues.jp:
ま、さくらの方が、ばあちゃんにかわいがられ
てたからな……。
dialogues.en: Well, grandma always thought Sakura was cuter anyway...
dialogues.text: Well, grandma always thought Sakura was cuter anyway...

dialogues.jp: ちょっと複雑な気持ちになる。
dialogues.en: I started to feel a little jealous.
dialogues.text: I started to feel a little jealous.

dialogues.jp: が、今は環を助けられるなら、何だっていい。
dialogues.en: But if it's to save Tamaki, I don't care what it takes.
dialogues.text: But if it's to save Tamaki, I don't care what it takes.

dialogues.jp: 「さくら、行くぞ」
dialogues.en: "Sakura, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Sakura, let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: 俺達は早足に病院を後にした。
dialogues.en: We hurriedly exited the hospital through the back.
dialogues.text: We hurriedly exited the hospital through the back.

dialogues.jp: 俺とさくらと環は、枯れない桜の前に到着する。
dialogues.en:
Sakura, Tamaki and I eventually reached the Unwithering
Sakura.
dialogues.text:
Sakura, Tamaki and I eventually reached the Unwithering
Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの話では、ここが一番いいということだっ
た。
dialogues.en:
According to Sakura, this was the best place to carry the
plan out.
dialogues.text:
According to Sakura, this was the best place to carry the
plan out.

dialogues.jp:
すっかり枯れて、花びらはもう無いけれど、そ
れでもここが一番落ち着くのだという。
dialogues.en:
Even though it's completely withered and no more petals
remained, this was still the calmest place for her.
dialogues.text:
Even though it's completely withered and no more petals
remained, this was still the calmest place for her.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "...Now then."
dialogues.text: "...Now then."

dialogues.jp:
俺はさくらに言われたとおり、環を枯れない桜
の下に座らせ、幹にもたれさせた。
dialogues.en:
I followed as Sakura said, laying Tamaki carefully against
the Unwithering Sakura tree trunk.
dialogues.text:
I followed as Sakura said, laying Tamaki carefully against
the Unwithering Sakura tree trunk.

dialogues.jp: 環はやはり、まだ目覚めない。
dialogues.en: She still hadn't woken up despite all that movement.
dialogues.text: She still hadn't woken up despite all that movement.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、本当にいいの？」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chan, are you really okay with this?"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chan, are you really okay with this?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「でも……ボク、やっぱり……」
dialogues.en: "But... I may not be..."
dialogues.text: "But... I may not be..."

dialogues.jp:
よほど気が進まないのか、さくらはまだ決断を
鈍っている。
dialogues.en: Even to the end, Sakura was still plagued by indecisiveness.
dialogues.text: Even to the end, Sakura was still plagued by indecisiveness.

dialogues.jp: 「頼む、さくら」
dialogues.en: "Sakura, please..."
dialogues.text: "Sakura, please..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お前の力が必要なんだ」
dialogues.en: "I need your strength."
dialogues.text: "I need your strength."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もう、俺の答えは決まってるんだ」
dialogues.en: "My answer was decided long ago."
dialogues.text: "My answer was decided long ago."

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、人形のように動かない環の手を取っ
た。
dialogues.en: Sakura took the hand of the doll-like Tamaki.
dialogues.text: Sakura took the hand of the doll-like Tamaki.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、いいね。お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Okay then... onii-chan."
dialogues.text: "Okay then... onii-chan."

dialogues.jp: 俺はゆっくりと頷く。
dialogues.en: I slowly nodded.
dialogues.text: I slowly nodded.

dialogues.jp: さくらは反対の手で俺とも手をつなぐ。
dialogues.en: I took a firm hold onto Sakura's other hand.
dialogues.text: I took a firm hold onto Sakura's other hand.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「いい？　多分、ボクが呼びかけると、環ちゃ
　ん、拒否するかもしれないからお兄ちゃんが
　呼びかけてね」
dialogues.en:
"She'd almost certainly reject me... so you have to call out
to her, okay?"
dialogues.text:
"She'd almost certainly reject me... so you have to call out
to her, okay?"

dialogues.jp: さくらが俺に注意事項を伝える。
dialogues.en: She quickly relayed to me the important points.
dialogues.text: She quickly relayed to me the important points.

dialogues.jp: 「拒否……するかもしれないのか」
dialogues.en: "She...might reject me too."
dialogues.text: "She...might reject me too."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あたりまえでしょ。自分の夢の中を意識的に
　見せるなんて、本当に好きで信頼している人
　しかダメなんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Of course. After all, to have the one she loves and trust
the most force his way into her dreams..."
dialogues.text:
"Of course. After all, to have the one she loves and trust
the most force his way into her dreams..."

dialogues.jp: そういうことか。
dialogues.en: That is true.
dialogues.text: That is true.

dialogues.jp:
ましてや、心を閉ざして意識が無いなら、なお
更ガードは固くなってるんだろう。
dialogues.en:
With Tamaki's closed heart and lack of consciousness, her
guard must've lessened.
dialogues.text:
With Tamaki's closed heart and lack of consciousness, her
guard must've lessened.

dialogues.jp:
ここにきて、あらためて俺は、今からやろうと
していることの重大さに気がつく。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's words just served to remind me of the gravity of
the situation.
dialogues.text:
Sakura's words just served to remind me of the gravity of
the situation.

dialogues.jp: 故意に人の意識の中に踏み込むこと……。
dialogues.en:
I'm basically carrying out a breaking-and-entering mission
into her consciousness...
dialogues.text:
I'm basically carrying out a breaking-and-entering mission
into her consciousness...

dialogues.jp:
それは、本来なら許されることではないのかも
しれない。
dialogues.en: It may well be something that's considered unforgivable.
dialogues.text: It may well be something that's considered unforgivable.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、目を閉じて」
dialogues.en: "Close your eyes."
dialogues.text: "Close your eyes."

dialogues.jp: 俺はさくらに言われた通り、目をつぶる。
dialogues.en: My eyelids shut tightly.
dialogues.text: My eyelids shut tightly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ボクが１０数えたら、お兄ちゃんも環ちゃん
　の夢の中に入れるから」
dialogues.en: "On the count of 10, you will enter Tamaki's dream."
dialogues.text: "On the count of 10, you will enter Tamaki's dream."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ちゃんと環ちゃんを呼んであげてね。できる
　限り、優しい声で」
dialogues.en:
"Call out to her then, with as kind and gentle a voice as
possible."
dialogues.text:
"Call out to her then, with as kind and gentle a voice as
possible."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「心を開いて、素直にならないとダメだよ」
dialogues.en: "To open her heart, you have to be as earnest as you can."
dialogues.text: "To open her heart, you have to be as earnest as you can."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Right..."
dialogues.text: "Right..."

dialogues.jp: 環、今行くからな……待ってろ。
dialogues.en: Tamaki, I'm on my way... just wait right there for me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki, I'm on my way... just wait right there for me.

dialogues.jp: さくらがカウントを始める。
dialogues.en: Sakura began counting.
dialogues.text: Sakura began counting.

dialogues.jp: １０、数え終わると……。
dialogues.en: Once she finished saying 10...
dialogues.text: Once she finished saying 10...

dialogues.jp:
俺の意識はすうっとまどろみに落ちていった
……。
dialogues.en: I felt like I was suddenly taking a huge dive.
dialogues.text: I felt like I was suddenly taking a huge dive.

dialogues.en: ...Tamaki.
dialogues.text: ...Tamaki.

dialogues.en: ...Tamaki.
dialogues.text: ...Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の名前を呼び続ける。
dialogues.en: I continuously called out her name in my mind.
dialogues.text: I continuously called out her name in my mind.

dialogues.jp: 俺はここにいるよ……。
dialogues.en: I'm here...
dialogues.text: I'm here...

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、ごめん……」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chan, sorry..."
dialogues.text: "Onii-chan, sorry..."

dialogues.jp: 小さく、さくらの謝る声が心に伝わってくる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's small, apologetic voice reverberated around my
mind.
dialogues.text:
Sakura's small, apologetic voice reverberated around my
mind.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクはそっちに行けないみたい……」
dialogues.en: "It looks like I can't go inside..."
dialogues.text: "It looks like I can't go inside..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「無事に帰ってきてね……」
dialogues.en: "Please come back safely..."
dialogues.text: "Please come back safely..."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、さくらの声は消えていく。
dialogues.en: Upon saying that, her voice disappeared into the abyss.
dialogues.text: Upon saying that, her voice disappeared into the abyss.

dialogues.jp: 「……ああ、帰るさ」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, I will."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, I will."

dialogues.jp: 「環と一緒にな……」
dialogues.en: "With Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "With Tamaki..."

dialogues.en: Tamaki...
dialogues.text: Tamaki...

dialogues.jp: 俺はもう一度、環の名前を呼ぶ。
dialogues.en: I called out her name, once again.
dialogues.text: I called out her name, once again.

dialogues.jp: すると、白い視界が、急に色を帯びてきた。
dialogues.en:
The whiteness in front of me suddenly exploded into a field
of colour.
dialogues.text:
The whiteness in front of me suddenly exploded into a field
of colour.

dialogues.jp: ここは。
dialogues.en: This is...
dialogues.text: This is...

dialogues.jp: 枯れない桜が見える。
dialogues.en: The Unwithering Sakura greeted my eyes.
dialogues.text: The Unwithering Sakura greeted my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
桜は枯れたはずの桜が、ここでは無数の花びら
を散らしている。
dialogues.en:
An Unwithering Sakura tree, with countless petals dancing
around it.
dialogues.text:
An Unwithering Sakura tree, with countless petals dancing
around it.

dialogues.jp:
その木の下で……。静かに巫女装束でたたずむ
環がいる。
dialogues.en: At the bottom of that tree... stood Tamaki.
dialogues.text: At the bottom of that tree... stood Tamaki.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp: 俺の呼びかけに、環がゆっくりと振り返る。
dialogues.en: As I called out, Tamaki slowly turned around to face me.
dialogues.text: As I called out, Tamaki slowly turned around to face me.

dialogues.jp: しかし、その顔に笑顔は無い。
dialogues.en: But that face held no smile, which I had come to expect.
dialogues.text: But that face held no smile, which I had come to expect.

dialogues.jp:
ここは環の夢の世界。環の望む世界であるはず
なのに……。
dialogues.en:
This is Tamaki's dream world... the world that Tamaki wished
for...
dialogues.text:
This is Tamaki's dream world... the world that Tamaki wished
for...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様……どうして？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama... why?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama... why?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "...Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "...Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: 環は、俺をまっすぐ見詰める。
dialogues.en: Tamaki stared straight and hard at me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki stared straight and hard at me.

dialogues.jp: 「環、目を覚ますんだ」
dialogues.en: Tamaki, open your eyes."
dialogues.text: Tamaki, open your eyes."

dialogues.jp: 環は、自分の長い髪を手で触れる。
dialogues.en: She stroked her own long hair.
dialogues.text: She stroked her own long hair.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「見てください。桜、満開ですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Please look all around you... the sakura are in full
bloom."
dialogues.text:
"Please look all around you... the sakura are in full
bloom."

dialogues.jp: 環は、俺の問いかけには答えず、話を始める。
dialogues.en: Ignoring my question, she began to talk.
dialogues.text: Ignoring my question, she began to talk.

dialogues.jp:
その声に呼応するかのように、桜の花びらたち
は一斉にざわめき、散っていく。
dialogues.en:
Each word that we spoke seemed to stir the sakura petals
into action.
dialogues.text:
Each word that we spoke seemed to stir the sakura petals
into action.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくし、朝倉様のおばあさまに会いました」
dialogues.en: "I met Asakura-sama's grandmother."
dialogues.text: "I met Asakura-sama's grandmother."

dialogues.jp: え？
dialogues.en: Eh?
dialogues.text: Eh?

dialogues.jp: ばあちゃんに？
dialogues.en: She met grandma?
dialogues.text: She met grandma?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「素敵な方ですね。さくらさんによく似てます」
dialogues.en:
"She's a wonderful person. Sakura-san really takes after her
looks."
dialogues.text:
"She's a wonderful person. Sakura-san really takes after her
looks."

dialogues.jp: 一瞬、環の顔に淋しげな笑顔がうつる。
dialogues.en: Her face then showed a sad, lonely smile.
dialogues.text: Her face then showed a sad, lonely smile.

dialogues.jp:
この場所には、ばあちゃんの想いもきっとたく
さん残っている。
dialogues.en:
This place... grandma's feelings and thoughts are no doubt
left here.
dialogues.text:
This place... grandma's feelings and thoughts are no doubt
left here.

dialogues.jp:
環が昔、ばあちゃんに出会っていたことで、想
いを呼び寄せたのだろうか。
dialogues.en: Did Tamaki dream up the scenery where she met grandma?
dialogues.text: Did Tamaki dream up the scenery where she met grandma?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「人は……どうしたら、自分の気持ちに素直に
　なれるんでしょう？」
dialogues.en: "Why... do people obediently follow their own feelings?"
dialogues.text: "Why... do people obediently follow their own feelings?"

dialogues.jp: 環は、髪についた桜の花びらをつまむ。
dialogues.en: She plucked a stray petal in her hair.
dialogues.text: She plucked a stray petal in her hair.

dialogues.jp:
その仕草が、あまりにも美しすぎて、つい見と
れてしまう。
dialogues.en: Just that action alone showed her beauty.
dialogues.text: Just that action alone showed her beauty.

dialogues.jp:
この、ずっと変わらない世界に、環を住まわせ
ておきたいほど、美しいと思った。
dialogues.en:
The thought of her residing forever on an unchanging world,
was poetic in a way.
dialogues.text:
The thought of her residing forever on an unchanging world,
was poetic in a way.

dialogues.jp:
壊れることのない、悩むことも迷うこともない
この美しい世界に。
dialogues.en:
A beautiful world, where nothing can be broken, and no one
would lose their way.
dialogues.text:
A beautiful world, where nothing can be broken, and no one
would lose their way.

dialogues.jp: ──惑わされちゃダメだ。
dialogues.en: --I won't get distracted.
dialogues.text: --I won't get distracted.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環を連れに来たんだ。
dialogues.en: I came here to take Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I came here to take Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: このいつまでも何も変わらない世界から！
dialogues.en: Away from this boring, unchanging world!
dialogues.text: Away from this boring, unchanging world!

dialogues.jp: 「……帰ろう……環」
dialogues.en: "...Let's go back... Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "...Let's go back... Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: 環は静かに、首を横に振る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki silently shook her head.
dialogues.text: Tamaki silently shook her head.

dialogues.jp: 「な、帰ろう」
dialogues.en: "Come on, let's."
dialogues.text: "Come on, let's."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……帰らない」
dialogues.en: "...I won't go back."
dialogues.text: "...I won't go back."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「帰るんだ！　環！　ここはいつまでもいてい
　い場所じゃない」
dialogues.en: "Come back with me, Tamaki! You can't stay here forever!"
dialogues.text: "Come back with me, Tamaki! You can't stay here forever!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の手首を掴む。
dialogues.en: I seized her wrist.
dialogues.text: I seized her wrist.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あなたとは帰れない！！」
dialogues.en: "I won't go back with you!!"
dialogues.text: "I won't go back with you!!"

dialogues.jp: 環は手を振り解き、まっすぐに俺を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki wrestled my grip off, and continued her eerie stare.
dialogues.text: Tamaki wrestled my grip off, and continued her eerie stare.

dialogues.jp: その勢いに、思わず気圧されてしまう。
dialogues.en: That sudden vigor seemed like the heavens pushing me off.
dialogues.text: That sudden vigor seemed like the heavens pushing me off.

dialogues.jp: 環は、フッと口元に笑みを浮かべる。
dialogues.en: A tiny laugh started to play on her lips.
dialogues.text: A tiny laugh started to play on her lips.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「もう、わたくしには、何もなくなってしまっ
　たんです」
dialogues.en: "I do not have anything left anymore."
dialogues.text: "I do not have anything left anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「本当はずっと、普通の女の子になれたらって、
　思ってました」
dialogues.en:
"I've always thought that I wanted to just be a normal
girl."
dialogues.text:
"I've always thought that I wanted to just be a normal
girl."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「でも、巫女であることを辞めたら、わたくし
　はわたくしでいられるのかなって……」
dialogues.en:
But the day I retire myself as a Miko, would be the day I
lose myself..."
dialogues.text:
But the day I retire myself as a Miko, would be the day I
lose myself..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、枯れない桜の幹に手を当てる。
dialogues.en: She stroked the trunk of the tree tenderly.
dialogues.text: She stroked the trunk of the tree tenderly.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「巫女じゃないわたくしが、どんなわたくしか、
　わからないんです……」
dialogues.en:
"I do not know what kind of person I would be, if I were not
a Miko..."
dialogues.text:
"I do not know what kind of person I would be, if I were not
a Miko..."

dialogues.jp: 環の目に、うっすらと涙が浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: Tears started to swell in her eyes.
dialogues.text: Tears started to swell in her eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「わたくしじゃないわたくしが、そのままの気
　持ちでいられるんだろうかって……」
dialogues.en:
"Or whether the myself I'm not, would hold the same
feelings..."
dialogues.text:
"Or whether the myself I'm not, would hold the same
feelings..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あなたのことを好きな、わたくしでいられる
　のかって……」
dialogues.en: "The same feelings of love for you..."
dialogues.text: "The same feelings of love for you..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp:
と、言おうとしても、声がかすれてうまく音に
ならない。
dialogues.en: Her voice rang clearly through the empty dreamland.
dialogues.text: Her voice rang clearly through the empty dreamland.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「自分自身が、もう……」
dialogues.en: "The way I am, I can't..."
dialogues.text: "The way I am, I can't..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……こんな気持ちじゃ帰れない！」
dialogues.en: "...I can't go back with these feelings!"
dialogues.text: "...I can't go back with these feelings!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「こんな、何もかもわからない、何も無い、わ
　たくしなんて……」
dialogues.en: "I do not know anything anymore, I am no longer myself..."
dialogues.text: "I do not know anything anymore, I am no longer myself..."

dialogues.jp: 環の頬を、一筋の涙が流れていく。
dialogues.en: Her tears began to stream down her face.
dialogues.text: Her tears began to stream down her face.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「きっと、朝倉様は、そんな私のこと、好きに
　なってはくれないですよね」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama would never love a person like that..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama would never love a person like that..."

dialogues.jp: 環は俺を見て、弱々しく微笑む。
dialogues.en: She smiled weakly, turning her gaze away.
dialogues.text: She smiled weakly, turning her gaze away.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……あなたのことが、こんなにも好きなのに」
dialogues.en: "...Even though I love you so much."
dialogues.text: "...Even though I love you so much."

dialogues.jp: 環の涙は、止まらない。
dialogues.en: Her tears continued endlessly.
dialogues.text: Her tears continued endlessly.

dialogues.jp: 巫女であるべきか、女の子であるべきか。
dialogues.en: The duties of a Miko, as opposed to the needs of a woman.
dialogues.text: The duties of a Miko, as opposed to the needs of a woman.

dialogues.jp:
巫女を捨てたら、自分ははたして今の自分でい
られるのか。
dialogues.en:
If she threw away what she had now, she wouldn't know what
she was anymore.
dialogues.text:
If she threw away what she had now, she wouldn't know what
she was anymore.

dialogues.jp:
子どもの頃から、巫女として生きてきた自分は
果たしてどうなってしまうのか。
dialogues.en:
She was brought up as a kid to think that the life of a Miko
was her destiny.
dialogues.text:
She was brought up as a kid to think that the life of a Miko
was her destiny.

dialogues.jp:
思い出せない俺との『深い絆』を信じて生きて
きた自分が、巫女を捨ててしまったら……。
dialogues.en:
But believing in that deep bond that she couldn't even
remember, she cast her Miko self aside...
dialogues.text:
But believing in that deep bond that she couldn't even
remember, she cast her Miko self aside...

dialogues.en: "...Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "...Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: 何、言ってんだよ。
dialogues.en: What are you talking about...
dialogues.text: What are you talking about...

dialogues.jp: そんなことで……。
dialogues.en: Those kind of things...
dialogues.text: Those kind of things...

dialogues.jp: そんなことで悩むなよ。
dialogues.en: They're nothing to worry about, at all.
dialogues.text: They're nothing to worry about, at all.

dialogues.jp: バカ。
dialogues.en: Stupid...
dialogues.text: Stupid...

dialogues.jp:
俺は溢れてくる、今にも爆発しそうな想いを、
言葉にする。
dialogues.en:
The emotions that were boiling inside me finally burst out
into words.
dialogues.text:
The emotions that were boiling inside me finally burst out
into words.

dialogues.jp: 「環……違うよ」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki... you're wrong."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki... you're wrong."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.jp: 環は驚いた顔で俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki turned towards me, shocked.
dialogues.text: Tamaki turned towards me, shocked.

dialogues.jp:
「別に俺は、環が巫女だから好きになった訳じゃ
　ない」
dialogues.en: "I didn't love you because you were a Miko."
dialogues.text: "I didn't love you because you were a Miko."

dialogues.jp:
「『深い絆』で結ばれている｛・・／許嫁｝だから、一緒
　にいたんじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"Neither did I want to be with you because of this deep
bond, this childhood engagement."
dialogues.text:
"Neither did I want to be with you because of this deep
bond, this childhood engagement."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺は……俺は、お前が好きなんだよ！」
dialogues.en: "I... I just love you, that's all!"
dialogues.text: "I... I just love you, that's all!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「巫女だろうが、なんだろうが、どうでもいい。
　俺は、ありのままの、環を見てた」
dialogues.en:
"Whether you're a Miko or whatever, the person I was looking
at was always Tamaki."
dialogues.text:
"Whether you're a Miko or whatever, the person I was looking
at was always Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いろんなことに一生懸命なところとか、みん
　なのために頑張るところとか、普通の女の子
　に憧れているところとか」
dialogues.en:
"The normal girl who worked hard and put all her heart into
all sorts of things."
dialogues.text:
"The normal girl who worked hard and put all her heart into
all sorts of things."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「全部、全部……見てた」
dialogues.en: "All... all of that... was what I saw."
dialogues.text: "All... all of that... was what I saw."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「結ばれない未来だって関係なかった。俺は、
　俺の意思で、環を好きになり、環に告白した
　んだ」
dialogues.en:
"Unconnected futures have nothing to do with it. I loved
you, and confessed to you, on my own feelings."
dialogues.text:
"Unconnected futures have nothing to do with it. I loved
you, and confessed to you, on my own feelings."

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の腕を掴み、抱きしめる。
dialogues.en: I took her into my arms, embracing her tightly.
dialogues.text: I took her into my arms, embracing her tightly.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「未来は、俺達の手で作っていかなきゃ」
dialogues.en: "The future's made by no one but ourselves."
dialogues.text: "The future's made by no one but ourselves."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、更に腕に力を込める。
dialogues.en: I put even more strength in my hug.
dialogues.text: I put even more strength in my hug.

dialogues.jp:
「──俺は、どんなことがあっても、環のこと
　が好きだよ」
dialogues.en: "--No matter what happens... I'd always love you."
dialogues.text: "--No matter what happens... I'd always love you."

dialogues.jp: 環の耳元でそっと｛ささや／囁｝く。
dialogues.en: I whispered those words into her ear.
dialogues.text: I whispered those words into her ear.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「本当に……わたくしでいいんですか……？」
dialogues.en: "Am I... really good enough...?"
dialogues.text: "Am I... really good enough...?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「当たり前だろ」
dialogues.en: "Of course you are."
dialogues.text: "Of course you are."

dialogues.jp: 俺は環の背中をそっと撫でる。
dialogues.en: I gently stroked her back.
dialogues.text: I gently stroked her back.

dialogues.jp: 「お前じゃなきゃ、だめなんだよ」
dialogues.en: "No one else is good enough, except you."
dialogues.text: "No one else is good enough, except you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺と環は、結ばれる運命なんだ……」
dialogues.en: "You and I are bonded by fate, after all..."
dialogues.text: "You and I are bonded by fate, after all..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくし……愛されてたんですね」
dialogues.en: "I am... in love."
dialogues.text: "I am... in love."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "...Yeah."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「やっと気がつきました」
dialogues.en: "...I finally know what it means."
dialogues.text: "...I finally know what it means."

dialogues.jp: 環が、ぎゅっと俺の身体を強く抱きしめる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki returned my hug, squeezing me as tightly as I was to
her.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki returned my hug, squeezing me as tightly as I was to
her.

dialogues.jp: 「このまま、一緒に帰ろう」
dialogues.en: "Let's go back, together."
dialogues.text: "Let's go back, together."

dialogues.jp: 環も、俺を抱きしめる手に力が入る。
dialogues.en: I concentrated all the power I had into my arms.
dialogues.text: I concentrated all the power I had into my arms.

dialogues.jp: ｛まぶ／眩｝しい……。
dialogues.en: So bright...
dialogues.text: So bright...

dialogues.jp: それは太陽の眩しさだった。
dialogues.en: The sun was blinding.
dialogues.text: The sun was blinding.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お帰り」
dialogues.en: "Welcome back."
dialogues.text: "Welcome back."

dialogues.jp: 目を開けると、目の前にさくらが立っている。
dialogues.en: I opened my eyes, to see Sakura standing in front of me.
dialogues.text: I opened my eyes, to see Sakura standing in front of me.

dialogues.jp: 「ただいま……」
dialogues.en: "I'm back..."
dialogues.text: "I'm back..."

dialogues.jp: と、言った後に、俺はすぐ横を見る。
dialogues.en: As I spoke, I quickly looked to my side.
dialogues.text: As I spoke, I quickly looked to my side.

dialogues.jp: すると、眩しそうに目を開けた環がいた。
dialogues.en: She was just starting to open her eyes too.
dialogues.text: She was just starting to open her eyes too.

dialogues.jp: 俺は環に
dialogues.en: I opened my mouth,
dialogues.text: I opened my mouth,

dialogues.jp: 「おはよう」
dialogues.en: "Good morning!"
dialogues.text: "Good morning!"

dialogues.jp: と、声をかけた。
dialogues.en: My voice flowed out impetuously.
dialogues.text: My voice flowed out impetuously.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「よかった、二人とも、気がついたんだね」
dialogues.en: "You two managed to come back.. I'm glad."
dialogues.text: "You two managed to come back.. I'm glad."

dialogues.jp: さくらは笑顔で俺達を待っていてくれた。
dialogues.en: She had waited for us with a smile.
dialogues.text: She had waited for us with a smile.

dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Me too."
dialogues.text: "Me too."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「さ、病院でみんな、心配してるよ。早くかえ
　ろ」
dialogues.en:
"The hospital staff and Tamaki's father must be worried
sick... let's hurry back."
dialogues.text:
"The hospital staff and Tamaki's father must be worried
sick... let's hurry back."

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、そうだ。お父さんの許可は得てい
るが、病院の許可は得ていない。
dialogues.en:
Oh, right... we asked the father's permission, but not the
hospital.
dialogues.text:
Oh, right... we asked the father's permission, but not the
hospital.

dialogues.jp:
さくらは、うたまるを頭にのせ、俺達を帰るよ
うに促す。
dialogues.en: Sakura started moving out, with Utamaru riding on her head.
dialogues.text: Sakura started moving out, with Utamaru riding on her head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、ボクはうたまると先に行ってるね」
dialogues.en: "I'd head there first!"
dialogues.text: "I'd head there first!"

dialogues.jp: さくらは、さっさと俺達の前から去っていく。
dialogues.en: She ran ahead of us, towards the hospital.
dialogues.text: She ran ahead of us, towards the hospital.

dialogues.jp: 気を、利かせてくれたのかな……？
dialogues.en: Did she want to leave us alone...?
dialogues.text: Did she want to leave us alone...?

dialogues.jp: 「ふう」
dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、やっと少しずつ意識が固まってくる。
dialogues.en: The light-headedness finally started to subside.
dialogues.text: The light-headedness finally started to subside.

dialogues.jp: しかし、環の方は何やら呆然としている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki though, was still looking bamboozled.
dialogues.text: Tamaki though, was still looking bamboozled.

dialogues.jp: ま、長い間眠ってたから、無理もない……。
dialogues.en: Well, she has been sleeping for days, it's to be expected...
dialogues.text: Well, she has been sleeping for days, it's to be expected...

dialogues.jp: 「環、大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay, Tamaki?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay, Tamaki?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環の肩に手を置く。
dialogues.en: I placed my hand on her shoulder.
dialogues.text: I placed my hand on her shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……よかった」
dialogues.en: "...Good."
dialogues.text: "...Good."

dialogues.jp:
俺はもう一度──、今度は現実世界で環を抱き
しめる。
dialogues.en:
Once again-- but this time in the real world, I embraced her
tihgtly.
dialogues.text:
Once again-- but this time in the real world, I embraced her
tihgtly.

dialogues.jp: 目が覚めて、本当によかった。
dialogues.en: I'm so glad... that she woke up.
dialogues.text: I'm so glad... that she woke up.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様がいてくれた……」
dialogues.en: "Because you came for me..."
dialogues.text: "Because you came for me..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……俺はここにいるよ」
dialogues.en: "...I'll always be here."
dialogues.text: "...I'll always be here."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「迎えに来てくれて、ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for coming for me..."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for coming for me..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「わたくし、やっと気づいたことがあるんです」
dialogues.en: "I've finally understood."
dialogues.text: "I've finally understood."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「お父様や、お母様が言ってた、本当の意味が
　分かったんです」
dialogues.en: "The true meaning of what my mother said."
dialogues.text: "The true meaning of what my mother said."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……本当の意味？」
dialogues.en: "...The true meaning?"
dialogues.text: "...The true meaning?"

dialogues.jp: 環はコクリと頷いて、
dialogues.en: Tamaki nodded.
dialogues.text: Tamaki nodded.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「二人の深い絆の意味……」
dialogues.en: "The meaning of our deep bond..."
dialogues.text: "The meaning of our deep bond..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺も……わかったよ」
dialogues.en: "I... understand it now, too."
dialogues.text: "I... understand it now, too."

dialogues.jp:
深い絆。俺も環も、すっかり、昔の記憶の中に
それがあるものだとばかり思っていた。
dialogues.en:
That deep bond... we'd always thought it was something
hidden deep in our memories.
dialogues.text:
That deep bond... we'd always thought it was something
hidden deep in our memories.

dialogues.jp: 違うんだ。
dialogues.en: But we were wrong.
dialogues.text: But we were wrong.

dialogues.jp:
俺と環。子どもの時に初めて出会ってから、今
の今まで……。
dialogues.en: Tamaki and I. From the first time we met as kids...
dialogues.text: Tamaki and I. From the first time we met as kids...

dialogues.jp:
結ばれない未来があっても、苦しいほどの困難
があっても、俺と環は結ばれた。
dialogues.en:
No matter what unconnected futures we hard, or hardships and
difficulty, we were always bonded together.
dialogues.text:
No matter what unconnected futures we hard, or hardships and
difficulty, we were always bonded together.

dialogues.jp: いや、俺と環の意思で一緒になった。
dialogues.en: No... it's because of our own will.
dialogues.text: No... it's because of our own will.

dialogues.jp:
環のお母さんは、たぶんこのことを予知してい
たのだろう。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's mother probably foresaw that all this would happen.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's mother probably foresaw that all this would happen.

dialogues.jp:
二人の強い想いがもう一度、二人を引き合わせ、
結ばれる。
dialogues.en:
From our strong feelings for each other, we were connected
once again.
dialogues.text:
From our strong feelings for each other, we were connected
once again.

dialogues.jp: 「深い……深い絆だ」
dialogues.en: "It's a deep... deep bond."
dialogues.text: "It's a deep... deep bond."

dialogues.jp:
環のお母さんは、せめて自分達の意思で、未来
を選択できるよう、環に俺と深い絆で結ばれて
いることだけを伝えていたのだ。
dialogues.en:
Her mother foresaw our strong will, to make a future
together, that she told Tamaki that we were bonded.
dialogues.text:
Her mother foresaw our strong will, to make a future
together, that she told Tamaki that we were bonded.

dialogues.jp:
もし、お母さんの心遣いがなければ、俺と環は
こうして出会ったとしても、環が見た未来のよ
うに結ばれなかったかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
If it were not for her faith, who knows if the difficulties
we overcame, would've ended what we had.
dialogues.text:
If it were not for her faith, who knows if the difficulties
we overcame, would've ended what we had.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……これからも、ずっと一緒です」
dialogues.en: "...From now on, we'd always be together."
dialogues.text: "...From now on, we'd always be together."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "...Yeah."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah."

dialogues.jp: 俺は環を抱きしめる手に、力を入れた。
dialogues.en: I hugged her with all my might.
dialogues.text: I hugged her with all my might.

dialogues.jp: ◆深い絆◆
dialogues.en: ◆Deep Bond?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Deep Bond?◆

dialogues.jp:
さくらと俺は、環を救うため、環を外へと連れ
出す。
dialogues.en: Sakura and I took Tamaki outside, in order to save her.
dialogues.text: Sakura and I took Tamaki outside, in order to save her.

dialogues.jp:
枯れない桜の下で、俺とさくらは、環の夢の中
に潜り込み、環を説得する。
dialogues.en:
Under the Withering Sakura tree, Sakura and I entered
Tamaki's dream to try and convince her.
dialogues.text:
Under the Withering Sakura tree, Sakura and I entered
Tamaki's dream to try and convince her.

dialogues.jp:
気持ちを伝えあった環は、深い眠りの中から、
ようやく目覚めるのだった。
dialogues.en:
After telling her my feelings, Tamaki finally woke up from
her long and deep sleep.
dialogues.text:
After telling her my feelings, Tamaki finally woke up from
her long and deep sleep.

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺と環は、深い絆の本当の意味を知る
のだった。
dialogues.en:
At that moment, we found out the true meaning of our deep
bond.
dialogues.text:
At that moment, we found out the true meaning of our deep
bond.
